required_mounts.node_toolchain: a Linux Node install for this machine's architecture, at the version in .nvmrc -- a macOS build will not run in the sandbox
required_mounts.npm_cache: the npm cache directory, what `npm config get cache` prints
required_mounts.electron_cache: the Electron download cache electron's postinstall reads from, what `~/.cache/electron` holds once `npm ci` has fetched Electron on the host
required_mounts.node_gyp_cache: node-gyp's Node headers cache, what `~/.cache/node-gyp` holds once a native module has built against this Node version on the host
required_mounts.electron_gyp_cache: node-gyp's Electron headers cache used by `@electron/rebuild`, what `~/.electron-gyp` holds once `npm run rebuild` has run on the host
required_mounts.gcc_toolchain: a portable x86_64 glibc GCC toolchain for building node-pty's native addon -- the sandbox image ships no compiler and no apt mirror is reachable; see docs/sandbox.md for how it was fetched into .box/deps/
